app.title: Android Webcam
device.label: Device:
wifi.switch_tooltip: Enable TCP/IP mode and connect wirelessly
wifi.switched: ✓ Connected to {addr}! You can unplug USB.
camera.label: Camera Selection:
camera.front_warning: ⚠️ Note: Back camera usually has better resolution
camera.locked: 🔒 {apps} has the camera open, so resolution and camera are locked: a new size wouldn't reach it. To change them, release the camera in {apps} (in OBS: remove the camera source; in a browser: leave the call), change them here and press Start, then add the camera again in {apps} (or rejoin the call).
camera.locked_streaming: 🔒 {apps} is receiving the stream, so settings and Launch are locked: restarting would cut its video. Press Stop first to change anything. After a change, you may have to restart the streaming site or app (or reselect the camera in it) for it to take effect.
resolution.label: Resolution:
resolution.high_warning: ⚠️ High resolution/FPS may cause phone to overheat
fps.label: FPS Limit:
stream.launch_background_tooltip: Stream to the virtual webcam without the preview window (for OBS, Zoom, etc.)
status.crashed: ● Stream crashed at {res}. Try another resolution or camera.
status.relaunched: ⚠️ {res} crashed on this phone, relaunched at {fallback}
status.restarting: ⚠️ The stream stopped unexpectedly, restarting at {res}...
status.camera_busy: ● The phone's camera is in use by another app. Close it and press Launch again.
status.camera_blocked: ● The phone blocked camera access. Check the camera privacy toggle in Quick Settings.
status.no_audio_output: ● This PC has no audio output to play the phone's microphone. Turn on "Block Phone Microphone" or start your sound server, then press Launch again.
status.format_stuck: ⚠️ {apps} still has the camera open at {current}, so it can't show {res} (green or scrambled picture). Close its camera source, then press Start again. After a change, you may have to restart the streaming site or app (or reselect the camera in it) for it to take effect.
status.scrcpy_missing: ● scrcpy is not installed. See the README for how to install it.
status.scrcpy_too_old: ● scrcpy {version} is too old for camera mode (needs 2.2 or newer). See the README to install a newer one.
status.sink_reset_done: ⚠️ The virtual camera stopped accepting video and was reset
status.sink_busy: ● The virtual camera stopped accepting video and needs a reset, but {apps} is using it. Close it, then press Start again.
status.sink_reset_failed: ● The virtual camera stopped accepting video and couldn't be reset. Run "sudo modprobe -r v4l2loopback && sudo modprobe v4l2loopback", then press Start again.
waiting.title: Waiting for Android Device...
waiting.hint: Connect your phone via USB with USB Debugging enabled, or connect wirelessly over Wi-Fi below:
waiting.qr_tooltip: Pair and connect using Wireless Debugging, no USB cable needed
waiting.tip: Tip: Device and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. Requires initial USB setup or Android 11+ Wireless Debugging.
qr.title: Pair with QR Code
qr.steps: On your phone open {path} and scan this code.
qr.steps_path: Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with QR code
qr.note: Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. Discovery uses mDNS (UDP port 5353), so allow it in your firewall.
qr.waiting_scan: 🔄 Waiting for the phone to scan...
error.no_wifi_ip: Could not detect phone Wi-Fi IP address. Ensure Wi-Fi is active on phone.
error.connect: Connection failed. Please verify the IP and port.
error.pair_timeout: Timed out waiting for the phone. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and that mDNS (UDP 5353) isn't blocked by a firewall.
error.connect_port_timeout: Paired, but the phone did not announce its connect port. Enter the IP:port shown under Wireless debugging and press Connect.
